correctness.rationale: A finite rank-one sink kills exactly the cyclic spectral subspace, all other eigenstates remain unitary. Prime-cycle Bloch projectors give exact cosine weights; the only rational prime cosine relation has coefficient sum p, proving affine independence. Coprime-prime cyclotomic fields intersect over Q, while distinct nonzero cosine conjugates have trace-zero differences and are nonrational; hence rational anisotropy permits only same-mode coincidences, or swapped modes at equal isotropic prime square. The swap projector identity yields the 1/8 class and the unordered-pair rank. Every hypothesis and dimension count is specified. A separately executed direct diagonalization verified 24 model cases, 1,448 site values (maximum 9.714e-15 error), and all active subspace ranks. Finite checks are confirmatory only; no other parameter domains are claimed.
